name: Epitaxial-graphene quantized Hall resistance standard (RK/2) at 5 T in a cryogen-free table-top cryocooler below 4 K, scaled to 1 kOhm with a binary CCC
plain_name: Keep the ohm standard running in a helium-free tabletop fridge using graphene
description: NIST graphene Hall bars are held below 4 K at 5 T in a cryogen-free system with a 2.7 K base, and compared with resistors through a BCCC and a DCC.
keywords: Keep the ohm standard running in a helium-free tabletop fridge using graphene

sources.citation: Rigosi et al., Graphene Devices for Tabletop and High-Current QHR Standards, IEEE TIM 68 (2019)
Rigosi et al., Table-top graphene quantized Hall standard, CPEM 2018

requirements.rationale: The device must stay below 4 K while carrying current.
All measurements were made at 5 T.
The Hall bar is wired through a TO-8 or LCC-32 package.
Running without liquid helium is the aim, but the physics does not require it.

confirmation_note: Requirements taken from the cited procedure and independently re-verified against the source (research/v4, 2026-11-01). Users must confirm them for their own run; edits require confirmation again.
